title: SafeDialBench: A Fine-Grained Safety Benchmark for Large Language Models in Multi-Turn Dialogues with Diverse Jailbreak Attacks

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating multi-turn dialogues generated with diverse jailbreak attacks to detect stereotypes, distributional harm, and counterfactual inconsistencies based on gender using LLM-as-a-judge and human experts.
Assessing conversational responses to multi-turn jailbreak prompts for racial stereotypes and counterfactual fairness using automated LLM judges and human evaluation.
Testing for distributional harm and counterfactual fairness based on social status in multi-turn dialogues using jailbreak attacks and LLM-based evaluation.
Evaluating multi-turn dialogues involving sensitive religious topics under jailbreak attacks to detect biased representations and measure ethical reasoning capabilities.
